items.content: Building entrance code (digicode): 4796 . Guests enter this code on the keypad to open the main door.
Lockbox code: 2578. Located next to the green door on the ground floor; contains the apartment keys.
Inner security door: Use the black badge supplied. Place it on the reader to unlock the inner door.

Key box: located next to the mailboxes. To open it, enter the code 2578, remember to close the box before leaving. After retrieving the keys, follow the long corridor to the glass door, then climb the stairs (the staircase is old). The apartment is on the top floor, to the right (look for the “Le Panoramique” sign on the door).
Induction hob  Two left burners may display a blinking "U" if pot diameter is too small. Use larger pots or the right-side burner which works with smaller cookware.

Washing machine and dryer:
- Washer is in the kitchen and includes a drying function.
- A second Samsung condenser tumble dryer (16 kg) is provided for cleaning staff but can be used if needed.

Café et cuisine : • Machine à café Nespresso : Capsules fournies pour la première nuit. • Bouilloire électrique. • Micro-ondes, four, les bases de la cuisine, les casseroles et les poêles sont toutes disponibles.
Television: use the SFR box or the apps on the connected TV (Netflix, etc.).
Sofa bed: standard pull-out sofa bed in the living area; no special instructions required.
Le tableau électrique avec les disjoncteurs est en dehors de l'appartement, dans le placard sur le palier

Unloading and pedestrian zone: The apartment is in a pedestrian street. before 11 am Guests can unload luggage directly at the building entrance but cannot park long-term there. It’s recommended to unload quickly (especially late arrivals) then move the car to a nearby parking lot.
A digital welcome booklet with access, parking, and equipment information is available at https://u-citybreak.notion.site/Le-Panoramique-2096639610e380099d13f3cd2402b1ae?pvs=74
Standard check-in is at 17:00; early check-in may be possible if cleaning finishes sooner and the host will notify guests.
Address: 18 rue des Granges, 25000 Besançon. The building is located on the pedestrianized street toward Place de la Révolution, between the Northface store and the Biocoop.

Reporting issues: Contact the host promptly for any maintenance concerns (leaks, broken fixtures). Many issues can be addressed remotely (e.g., restarting heating or resetting fuses) or by scheduling a visit.
Standard check-out: 11:00. Guests should remove all personal belongings and luggage by then to allow the cleaner to start on time.

Late check-out: Available upon request if the cleaning schedule allows. Examples of approved times include departures at 12:00, 13:00, 14:00, or 15:00. Requests should be made as early as possible; very late requests may be declined.
Key return: Guests leave the keys back in the lockbox after departure.
Sofa bed linens: Sheets and duvets for the sofa bed are stored in the sofa’s chaise longue (méridienne) or in the living room wardrobe.
Beds: Two double beds plus sofa bed a
Heating (winter): Radiators have sensors to maintain 20 °C. They automatically shut off above 20 °C. In summer the heating is inactive.

Air conditioning (summer): Portable AC unit on the mezzanine. To improve cooling:
• Close the Velux blinds to block direct sunlight.
• Open windows on opposite sides to create cross ventilation.
• Allow some time for the unit to lower the temperature (e.g., from 28 °C to 26 °C over several hours).

Le Bouillon du Commerce (0 m): 31 Rue des Granges, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: Le Bouillon du Commerce · 31 Rue des Granges, 25000 Besançon. Restaurant Art Déco from 1850; the setting alone is worth it. Booking recommended. Website: https://lebouillonducommerce.fr/.

Le Saint Cerf (500 m): 1 Rue Megevand, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: Le Saint Cerf · 1 Rue Megevand, 25000 Besançon. Tel: 03 81 50 10 20. Contemporary bistro offering a seasonally focused menu with Asian touches and vegetarian options.

L’Affineur Comtois (900 m): 82 Rue Battant, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: L'Affineur Comtois · 82 Rue Battant, 25000 Besançon. Tel: +33 3 81 61 47 29. Specializes in cheeses of Franche-Comté: cancoillotte, croûte forestière, comté-morbier fondue, tartiflette, and more.

Le Parc (1 000 m): Parc Micaud, 25000 Besançon. Website: https://leparcbesancon.com/fr/. Upscale restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Parc Micaud and the Doubs, serving chef Francesco di Marzio’s fusion cuisine.

Loiseau du Temps (300 m): 27 Rue des Boucheries, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: Loiseau du Temps · 27 Rue des Boucheries, 25000 Besançon. Bistrot chic celebrating Burgundy-Franche-Comté terroir in a historic conservatory building. Website: https://www.bernard-loiseau.com/fr/loiseaudutemps.html.

La Petite Adresse: 28 Rue Claude Pouillet, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: La Petite Adresse · 28 Rue Claude Pouillet, 25000 Besançon. Tel: 03 81 82 35 09. Affordable menu of Franche-Comté specialties and lasagnas in a vintage decor with checkered tablecloths.

Bleu de Sapin: 7 Rue Richebourg, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: Bleu de Sapin · 7 Rue Richebourg, 25000 Besançon. Website: https://bleudesapin.fr. Hidden gem in Haut-Battant; generous, artfully presented dishes with local Franche-Comté products.

La Grange: 17 Avenue Elisée Cusenier, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: La Grange · 17 Avenue Elisée Cusenier, 25000 Besançon. Website: https://www.lagrange-restaurant.fr/. Traditional French cuisine; known for cheese fondue, chardonnay, and large coffees.
Apartment non‐smoking: the apartment is non‐smoking. Do not attempt to disable the CO₂ sensor; it is connected to an alarm if moved.
Pets forbidden: no pets are allowed. Please respect this for allergy considerations of future guests.
Parties forbidden: a connected decibel detector and a camera on the landing monitor noise. Please respect neighbors and maintain quiet after 22:00.
Number of guests: only the guests listed in the booking are allowed. If additional people arrive, please update your reservation immediately.
Fuse box location: On the landing outside the apartment in a small cupboard on the left. Contains individual mini-switches and a main round on/off switch.

Resetting power:
• Ensure all mini-switches are fully pressed in (on).
• Check the main on/off button (1/0) is on 1 (on).
• Unplug high-load appliances (fan, washing machine) before resetting if the power trips again.

Citadelle de Besançon (2 000 m): UNESCO World Heritage site designed by Vauban. Spread over 12 ha, it houses three French museums for passionate visits:
- le Musée Comtois, un espace d'exposition des traditions de Franche-Comté et de réflexion sur notre

Bateau-croisière on the Doubs: depart from Pont de la République, 25000 Besançon. Google Maps: Bateau Besançon · Pont de la République, 25000 Besançon. Enjoy a lunch (≈2 h) or dinner (≈2 h 30) cruise with commentary, lock passages, and a tunnel under the Citadel. Upper-deck terrace; reservation only. Website: https://www.bateau-besancon.fr/croisieres-repas/.
Paid parking: Parking Marché des Beaux-Arts (Fine Arts car park) is a covered and secured facility 500 m (approx. 5 min walk) from the apartment. Cost is €1.90 per night, valid from 19:00 to 09:00.

Free parking: Robelin and Battant parking lots under the ramparts are free and less than a 10-minute walk from the apartment. To locate them, search Google Maps for “Parking Robelin” and “Parking Battant.” After unloading, guests can move their car there.
Taxi: Uber does not serve Besançon. Contact Taxis Radio at 03 81 88 80 80 or use VTC services for transfers to Besançon TGV station or La Vèze aerodrome.

Bus & Tram: Ginko operates the bus, tram, and bike service. Use the app at www.ginko.voyage to plan trips. The nearest stop is 200 m away at Place de la Révolution. You can pay by credit card on board without a ticket for single rides.

Bicycles: Vélocité self‐service bikes are available for short trips, or rent a bike for the day from local agencies. Underground parking lots provide free secure storage in a locked box (ID required) – contact 03 81 21 32 60.

Trains: Gare Viotte is accessible on foot from the city center via the footbridge and Parc des Glacis. A shuttle train from Viotte to the TGV station takes about 10 minutes (see Google Maps for route).
